sim._comment: Tuned 2026-10-15 with loadoutMatchup. At first pass (64 dmg / 1.9 aoe / 1.7 spread / 14 rounds) one tube decided every trench and building fight it could reach. Now a round that lands kills armored men in a burst of 1.4 cells, but the wide hitSpread scatters it several cells at range, so it punishes men bunched on an approach far more than it picks off a dispersed line, and six rounds give an attack a costly chance rather than a sure thing. It does not open an emplacement on its own. Range outreaches a wall nest (24 cells) and a rifle (22); the minimum range is the tube's dead zone, so a team rushed inside it must pack up or fight with the rifles it carries.
